reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper; it keeps the helper's inline 7.5% tolerance rather than using the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.ts.

duplication.why: Adds no new logic copies, but leaves the pre-existing inline tolerance formula that duplicates getApproxNumberThreshold, and the midpoint copies in forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts still sit outside the helper.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, the tree's shared place for the expected schedule amount.

scope.why: Two-line change to the helper plus matching test updates.

maintainability.why: Math.min over the range and amount - tolerance express 'lowest allowed value' directly and are easy to read; the rule is still not the only definition in the tree because other sites compute their own amount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff only edits the shared helper; it adds no new call sites that go around it.
